source.citation: Sathish Shanmugam, Write Telugu Alphabets, consonant మ packaged tracing guides res/drawable/dot_stroke_c_5_5_ma.png and res/drawable/line_stroke_c_5_5_ma.png, movements 1–7 (version 2.6)
source.variation: The packaged guide numbers the upper-left arch, two lower-left bowls, central shoulder, upper flourish, lower-right bowl, and outer-right shoulder as seven movements. The c_5_5 filename, its position after c_5_4 భ, and the pictured glyph agree that this guide teaches మ. Those numbers mark movements, not pen lifts: the lift count follows HP Labs India's isolated handwritten Telugu character data (hpl-telugu-iso-char, https://lipitk.sourceforge.net/datasets/teluguchardata.htm), counted from the native-writer prototypes in the MIT-licensed LipiTk 4.0 Telugu recognizer. Those counts say how many strokes writers use, not where they break, so the break keeps the guide's order and falls where the guide restarts at the separate right bowl. The centre lines are fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Telugu outline, which joins the flourish to the central shoulder.
